pr_comments: @mgol I believe this is fixed up now

I've updated this to try to minimize the change and reduce the extra bytes. Now this essentially just moves `jQuery.type` to core/toType.js. Originally I also inlined the `class2type` variable in the new file, but that forces the variable to also be initialized there, that variable is also used in [some](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/6c38ebbd47c6b0fa654733819bd5ae36c1ac6c48/src/var/hasOwn.js#L6) [other](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/6c38ebbd47c6b0fa654733819bd5ae36c1ac6c48/src/var/toString.js#L6) places which increases the changes (and gzip-bytes). Moving the `class2type` can be considered later. The [original version](https://github.com/jbedard/jquery/commit/bed23d1930803fcfc130982ff7b5c6d87d0ecc94) for reference.

Unfortunately this does still increase the size a bit. I'm surprised since it mainly just removes `jQuery.` and moves the `toType` up top
```
   raw     gz Compared to master @ 6c38ebbd47c6b0fa654733819bd5ae36c1ac6c48
   -16     +6 dist/jquery.js
   -23     +9 dist/jquery.min.js
```

issue_context.title: Deprecate jQuery.type
issue_context.body:
### Description ###
`jQuery.type` is insufficient to deal with the ever-increasing list of @@toStringTag values (cf. gh-3553, gh-3600). But since it is intended for internal use anyway, so we should treat it just like [`jQuery.isNumeric`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues/2960), [`jQuery.proxy`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues/2958), [`jQuery.now`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues/2959), and [`jQuery.camelCase`](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues/3384) by removing it from the public API.
